This email confirms the following updates to your account (C-7620):

1. **Billing Contact Confirmed**: Future invoices will be sent to **billing@contoso.dev**.
2. **Late Fee Refund**: A refund of **80** has been processed for the late fee and will reflect in your account shortly.

If you notice any discrepancies or need further assistance, please reply to this email or contact our support team.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
